notes: Not in 7's id list (q0710-q0715): added as LT11 added q0696 (LT12_CODE_NOTES A27). Clock only: size-timing writes per-scenario wall-clock seconds per world, the projection and the code / spec / design-text hashes; the worlds' return values are discarded unread and the output holds no rejection count, rate, p-value or status. The timing seed 20261597 x 100 + 98 is neither the registered size-check seed nor a declared derived seed (x 100 + 51, 52, 54, 61) nor the development seed (x 100 + 99); the command refuses those. Worlds use the labelled development placeholders (rho_census 0.64, receipt gaps 5 s / 30 s, correlation -0.20) while the census values are unfilled (timing only). Run on the collection host, not beside any memory-heavy job. DRAFT, not in queue/jobs. Promote only after: the LT12 design-text freeze (LIVE_TESTS_12.md design text frozen at sha256 a543db63baeb3e85ff2dfa0189478086216c708e59b36f6db575c6b84592b62d), the LT12 code and the independent science-reviewer code-freeze check of the census, gate and size-check code against LIVE_TESTS_12.md sections 1.8, 1.8.1 and 7 (8.4 step 3; it must confirm re-check fixes 1-2 in code, see docs/research_lab/LT12_CODE_NOTES.md), and never while E015's or E022's analysis, or an LT9, LT10 or LT11 census, size check or analysis job, is running (memory-heavy-jobs rule; 7). Counts 0 (descriptive; no trials line) except q0715, which writes the single counted trials line (kind live_tests12). Reads the DRAFT spec unpinned (except q0714 and q0715, which read the pinned spec); the code_sha256 of every hashed module is written into the output. Every gate threshold is stated in section 7 before this runs; nothing is re-tuned after it. Restore, seal and census run ONCE each; max_retries 1 covers a deterministic crash only (no output written). Runs with --data-dumps-cap-gb 50 where the runner accepts it (exit 75 above the cap; 2026-10-28 ops convention, was 40).
